title: Show HN: Optio – Orchestrate AI coding agents in K8s to go from ticket to PR
summary: Open-source orchestration system that turns tickets into merged PRs using AI coding agents. Auto-resumes on CI failures, handles reviewer change requests, squash-merges automatically. Uses K8s pods, Claude Code or Codex. Key insight: feedback loop from CI/reviews back to agent.
pp_angle: Direct competitor to Permission Protocol's vision. They're solving 'agent autonomy' without explicit authorization layer. Risk: agents auto-merge without human approval gate.

title: Show HN: Urlx – an agent-made Rust replacement for curl/libcurl
summary: Same author as Optio. Claude Code reimplemented curl (180K lines C → Rust) in two ~16h iteration loops using test suite as spec. 100% of 1300 curl tests pass. Demonstrates agent can ship production-grade code autonomously.
pp_angle: Evidence that agents can ship complex code fast. The 'who approved this?' question becomes urgent when agents can rewrite core infrastructure.

title: Show HN: G0 – The control layer for AI agents (scan, test, monitor, comply)
summary: Security/governance tool for AI agents. Static+behavioral analysis, adversarial red teaming, runtime monitoring, compliance mapping (OWASP, NIST, EU AI Act). Has OpenClaw-specific support. Positions as 'the control layer'.
pp_angle: Competitor in governance space. Different positioning: they're security-audit focused, PP is authorization-primitive focused. Could be complementary (g0 scans, PP enforces).

title: Show HN: Agent Package Manager (APM) for Agent Configuration
summary: Microsoft/GitHub employee built open-source CLI to manage agent configs across Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor. Lock files, dependency resolution, supply-chain scanning. Deploys to multiple agents with one command.
pp_angle: Infrastructure layer for agent config. They're solving 'what configs does my agent have', we're solving 'what can my agent do'. Orthogonal but indicates enterprise appetite for agent governance.

title: Best AI Coding Agents 2026 - Product Hunt Categories
summary: Product Hunt now has dedicated AI Coding Agents category. Market validation: Cursor and Claude Code lead for repo-aware editing; Lovable emphasizes one-click deployment.
pp_angle: Market maturity signal. 'One-click deployment' is exactly the problem space - who controls that click?

title: Show HN: Optio – Orchestrate AI coding agents in K8s to go from ticket to PR
summary: Open-source orchestration for AI coding agents. Runs Claude Code/Codex in K8s, auto-merges PRs, self-heals on CI failures. No explicit governance/permission layer - validates PP positioning as the control layer these orchestrators need.
